preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10**5 for N, _, _ in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of friends N is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(N-1 <= M <= N*(N-1)/2 for _, M, _ in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of roads M satisfies N-1 ≤ M ≤ N*(N-1)/2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= M for _, _, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the road index K is between 1 and M inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= N and 1 <= B <= N and A != B for A, B, _ in roads)
preconditions.description: For each road, A and B are distinct friends between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= C <= 10**9 for _, _, C in roads)
preconditions.description: For each road, the length C is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(roads) == M for roads in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case contains exactly M roads.

postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two space-separated values.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c.isdigit() or c == '.' for c in value) for line in output_lines for value in line.split())
postconditions.description: Each output value is a valid decimal number.

postconditions.expression: all(len(value.split('.')[1]) == 5 for line in output_lines for value in line.split())
postconditions.description: Each output value is rounded to exactly 5 decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= distance_A <= 10**9 for line in output_lines for distance_A in [float(line.split()[0])])
postconditions.description: The first output value (distance from A) is non-negative and ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= max_dist <= 10**9 for line in output_lines for max_dist in [float(line.split()[1])])
postconditions.description: The second output value (max distance) is non-negative and ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= distance_A <= C for line, (A, B, C), _ in zip(output_lines, roads, test_cases) if K == 1)
postconditions.description: The distance from A to P is within the length of the K-th road (C).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= distance_A <= C for line, (A, B, C), K in zip(output_lines, roads, test_cases) if K == index + 1)
postconditions.description: The distance from A to P is within the length of the K-th road (C).

postconditions.expression: all(max_dist == max(dist(i) for i in range(1, N+1)) for line, (N, _, _), _ in zip(output_lines, test_cases, roads))
postconditions.description: The second output value is the maximum shortest distance from P to any friend.

postconditions.expression: all(distance_A == min(distance_A_candidate for distance_A_candidate in possible_distances) for line, possible_distances in zip(output_lines, possible_distances_list))
postconditions.description: The first output value is the smallest possible distance from A to P among all optimal solutions.
